limitations: Previously exposed authored development corpus; original validation preserved, not a fresh holdout.
Clause source context uses literal blank-line segmentation and exact verified cache lookup; it is not a general parser for arbitrary federal spans.
Structural clause-head permutation equivariance is not learned order recovery.
Raw scalar scores, generated relational binding, duplicate counts, EOS and whole-document exactness are distinct.
No order augmentation or generated-boundary auxiliary loss ran; source-only inference has no target count or forced closure.
No global optimum, native-family qualification, Lake build, production promotion or Constitution formalization is established.
outcome: Four fixed-budget fits completed. Ordered clause context is a richer source input; all unchanged acceptance gates, generated fidelity and corruption controls are reported per arm. No trained checkpoint passed selection; all four retained epoch 0.
reproducibility_scope: Artifact closure and original-path mapping; Python/host libraries and hardware are external. Encoder not executed in this training experiment.

resources.child_time_scope: includes monitoring and accounting before reap; excludes initial admission

telemetry.workload: Cached-embedding private decoder training; four fits with identical reference/update budgets; clause candidate has512fewer trainable parameters; no order augmentation or generated-boundary auxiliary loss.
